name: Stacie
material: plastic; synthetic fabric; velcro; elastic; metal
summary: Bowling Stacie was made in China by Mattel in the 1990s. She has a spring- loaded right arm and a magnet on her right hand in order for her to bowl. She comes wearing a long-sleeved t-shirt with a bowling motif on her chest, and pink trousers.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
